title: successors do not re-run constructor invariants
purpose: Observe object, role, cap and successor semantics.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.4: successor actions do not implicitly run constructors and MUST validate their own transitions (R19 finding): the unchecked successor yields -15; the explicitly checked one throws.
